entities.text: Bellapu Bharadwaj vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.8914 of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner, who is arrayed as accused, to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.89 of 2023 on the file of Market Police Station, Hyderabad District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 506 and 120-b of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard Sri Gandham S.R. Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S. Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1- State.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that though this Court issued notice to the Investigating Officer under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C., and directed the petitioner to appear before the Investigation Officer on or before 18.08.2023 in Criminal Petition No.7395 of 2023, the petitioner was not appeared before the Investigating Officer on the said date due to the sudden demise of his father.

4. In the view of the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and circumstances of the case, without going into the merits of the case, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the guidelines formulated by the Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously and shall consider the explanation offered by the petitioner and complete the investigation in accordance with law.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.

Note:
